availability: No estimate has exceedance1 at every finite threshold; operational removal available iff remaining_count>=3. Each comparison shares the same predeclared population denominator.
curve: Right-continuous empirical Pr(error>tau); union of every finite left/right score and zero is the complete breakpoint set; no fixed application threshold and no tail truncation in the probability definition.
knowledge: Core distributions and published step1-4 examples already observed; descriptive exact-curve synthesis locked before this computation. D3 identity selection and grid separately locked before new D3 errors. No inference of prospective blindness for earlier findings.

numerical_canonicalization.rule: For paired available scores only, if abs(left-right)<=1e-6+1e-12*max(left,right), align right to left for pair-curve comparisons. Original error arrays not changed. Per comparison retain count and maximum adjustment.

report: positive/negative signed areas to maximum finite breakpoint
terminal coverage gap for all larger finite thresholds
integral identity for both arms fully available
complete per-field message errors as lossless curve basis with extraction CLI
predeclared draw0 frozen/unrestricted curves for every cell,kappa,D,full/affected
operational removal comparison draw0 for every cell,kappa,D,full/affected
scope: All positive displacement fields in step4 real core and all newly locked D3 targets; six fixed populations; does not rerun C2 simulations.
sign: Positive benefit = left exceedance probability minus right exceedance probability; right is better at that threshold.
statistical_scope: Finite empirical distribution comparisons; no population stochastic-dominance inference, hypothesis tests, independent-message assumption, or outcome-selected cutoff.
